integrity.claim_scope: Frobenius cycles, extension counts, zeta functions and Chebotarev densities of a degree-48 proper sextactic scheme

scientific_limitations: Characteristic at least eleven; fixed Fermat model; no classification of twists or characteristics 2,3,5,7. Geometric sextactic equations and the 48-point count are previously known. Precise public day of the 2009 primary paper is not established; 2012-08-28 refers to an independently day-dated related quartic-contact preprint, not a purported first date for the 2009 paper. Arithmetic priority provisional.
title: Four Frobenius spectra of Fermat-quartic sextactic points
